name: Social-volume spike with flat price — early crowd-attention entry
rationale: When daily social volume surges well above its recent baseline while the asset's short-horizon price return stays near flat, the crowd-attention event has not yet been reflected in price. Academic literature (Zhang et al., Chen et al.) documents that abnormally high social-media volume leads 1-3 day forward returns for liquid crypto assets; the crowd's capital has not yet followed its attention. The spike-plus-flat configuration harvests this lag: we enter before the purchasing wave the attention surge telegraphs, and exit via a social-volume collapse signal when the crowd's interest fades. Disconfirmer: if ret_Nd is already strongly positive (above breakout_ceiling) the move is priced in and we skip — chasing after attention has been fully monetised destroys the edge. The short time_stop enforces discipline: if the move hasn't started in a few days, the attention was noise. NOTE: DATA-BLOCKED — social_volume requires LUNARCRUSH_API_KEY; the spec is queued until a real point-in-time history is ingested. tier1 + low-confidence until validated out-of-sample; the deterministic Gate judges it only then.
catalyst: social_volume surges above fitted spike floor while recent price return remains flat
